# HeartMath Institute

> HeartMath Institute is a nonprofit research organization providing scientifically-backed tools, courses, and resources for stress reduction, emotional wellness, and heart-centered personal development through coherence-based practices.

Founded and headquartered in Santa Cruz, California, HeartMath Institute combines psychophysiological research with practical wellness techniques to help individuals, organizations, and communities achieve greater resilience, emotional balance, and interconnectedness through heart intelligence and coherence practices.

## Key Topics

- Heart Coherence
- Heart Intelligence
- Global Coherence Initiative
- Stress Management
- Emotional Wellness
- Resilience Training
- Physiological Coherence Model
- Heart-Centered Practices
- Personal Well-Being Survey
- Trauma Education
- Self-Regulation
- Scientific Research
- Emergency Responders
- Coherence Retreats
- HeartMath Tools

## Core Concepts & Products

- [HeartMath Institute](https://www.heartmath.org): Homepage for HeartMath Institute nonprofit with stress reduction tools and well-being resources.
- [Heart Coherence](https://www.heartmath.org/heart-coherence): Main product page covering personal, social, and global coherence science and technology.
- [Science of Coherence](https://www.heartmath.org/heart-coherence/science): Scientific research on heart coherence, psychophysiology, and HeartMath techniques.
- [Global Coherence](https://www.heartmath.org/heart-coherence/global): Global Coherence Initiative with app, resources on interconnectedness and collective consciousness.

## Resources & Tools

- [Resources](https://www.heartmath.org/resources): Resource library hub with well-being survey, courses, and support for educators and veterans.
- [HeartMath Tools](https://www.heartmath.org/resources/heartmath-tools): Overview of HeartMath wellness tools, retreats, and heart-centered practices.
- [Personal Well-Being Survey](https://www.heartmath.org/resources/personal-well-being-survey): Personal assessment tool for measuring well-being and coherence levels.
- [Solutions for Stress](https://www.heartmath.org/resources/solutions-for-stress): Stress management guide with self-assessment tools and resilience techniques.

## Education & Training

- [Courses](https://www.heartmath.org/resources/courses): Course catalog covering stress management, resilience, and trauma education.
- [Trauma Education for Humanitarian and Emergency Responders](https://www.heartmath.org/resources/courses/trauma): Free course on trauma education and resilience training for emergency responders.
- [Add Heart Podcast](https://www.heartmath.org/resources/add-heart/add-heart-podcast): Podcast series on heart intelligence, meditation, and personal development.

## Organization & Events

- [About HeartMath Institute](https://www.heartmath.org/about-us): Organization overview, leadership, governance, history, and research programs.
- [Events Calendar](https://www.heartmath.org/about-us/events): Calendar of HeartMath retreats, in-person events, and registrations in Santa Cruz.

## Insights & Research

- [The Healing Power of Love: How the Heart Supports Emotional and Physical Healing](https://www.heartmath.org/blog): Article on heart-centered healing, emotional wellness, and scientific research on compassion.
